mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activities ( user_id, title, category, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, notes, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{categoryCode}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMinutes}, #{notes}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()) )
mapper.update: UPDATE activities SET title = #{title}, end_time = #{endTime}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activities WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY start_time DESC
SELECT * FROM activities WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND end_time IS NULL ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1
